summary: Evening Star's yo-yo driven 3D platformer from the developers associated with Sonic Mania.

entries.title: Penny's Big Breakaway

emulation.notes: Run the PC version natively with current patches.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC at highest stable settings

primary.why: Penny's Big Breakaway released for Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, Windows, and Xbox Series X/S in 2024. Windows is the most flexible high-fidelity route; Switch originally had a 30fps cap before a later performance mode update.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version natively at 60fps or better where supported; use PS5 or Xbox Series X/S as equivalent console routes.

entries.remaster_caveats: Switch performance improved after launch with a performance mode, but PC remains the cleanest high-fidelity route.
